name: MoreTry Tianma X3+ V4 3x3 (MagLev)
description: The Moretry Tianma X3+ V4 3x3 (MagLev + UV) is the highly anticipated successor to the X3 V4, bringing a host of new improvements while maintaining the features you loved. This cube is designed for maximum performance, precision, and customization, perfect for solvers who demand the best.
features: Redesigned internals reduce noise significantly, offering a smoother and quieter solving experience—perfect for any setting.
Innovative magnet pods make assembly and disassembly easier than ever, giving you more control over your cube.
Enlarged corner base magnets interact with center magnets to aid in precise alignment for effortless turning.
MagLev Technology: The magnetic levitation system now features 6 magnetic rings for more consistent and linear tension, ensuring optimal speed and stability.
